purpose: keep name resolution reliable and secure through controlled day-to-day changes and monitoring
entry_criteria: DNS zones and records are inventoried (stage 134)
Change process and access controls exist
procedure: Handle each record change as a reviewed change in code with the requester, reason and ticket recorded.
Check the impact before the change: who depends on the name, TTL and propagation, and rollback.
Apply the change and verify from several networks and resolvers, not only from the office.
Monitor resolution time and failures, and alert when the authoritative servers or records misbehave.
Audit records regularly for stale, duplicate and dangling entries and remove them.
Test the recovery path: restoring zones from version control or backup.
acceptance_criteria: Every change is traceable to a request and reviewed
Verification was done from multiple resolvers
Stale and dangling records are removed

validation.command: for r in one.one.one.one dns.google dns9.quad9.net; do dig @$r +short app.example.com; done   # example
validation.expect: all resolvers return the intended answer

validation.check: restore the zone from version control into a test zone and compare

failure_modes.mode: Stale record points to released infrastructure

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A request to move a service to a new address is applied through a reviewed change, the TTL is lowered a day before, and three public resolvers return the new address within the TTL; the old record is removed after a week.
